bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). CONSOLIDATED basis (explicitly titled 'Consolidated Balance Sheet' / 'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account'; includes subsidiary SBAC Bank Investment Limited, consistent with this bank's own 2021_Q2/Q3.json). No Solo alternative presented in this interim filing; Non-controlling interest is now folded directly into the 'TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY' line as one of six components (rather than added on afterward as in the 2021 vintage) and remains immaterial (Tk.407,437 against total equity of Tk.10,910.86m, 0.004%). New this quarter: a 'Foreign currency translation reserve' equity line (matching this dataset's existing foreign_currency_translation_reserve schema field, first seen in FY2023+ SBACBANK filings) and the Bank now also runs an Islamic-banking window (Notes 4.2-4.2.4 give separate conventional/Islamic CRR and SLR disclosures). Total assets (94,567,983,335), total liabilities (83,657,123,972) and total equity (10,910,859,363, confirmed by total_assets-minus-total_liabilities and by summing the six reported equity components, which agree exactly) all reconcile. FRESH REGULATORY-FORBEARANCE LETTER FOUND, extending this dataset's now-multi-year documented pattern one year earlier than previously known: Note 8.5's own footnote cites TWO Bangladesh Bank letters -- (1) ref. DBI-3/132/2022-617 dated 19 April 2022, disclosing a total provision shortfall of Tk.55.79 crore (Tk.40.03 crore against unclassified loans and advances, Tk.11.12 crore against classified loans and advances, Tk.4.64 crore against COVID-19 special general provision); and (2) ref. DOS(CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2022-2224 dated 25 April 2022, which specifically permits deferring the Tk.11.12 crore classified-loan shortfall portion equally over 2022-2024. This DOS(CAMS)1157/41(dividend) letter series is the SAME series already documented in this bank's FY2023/2024/2025 quarterly and annual filings (...2023-2113, ...2024-1836, ...2025-3115) -- this 2022 letter (...2022-2224) is now the EARLIEST confirmed instance, extending the known forbearance-letter run to at least four consecutive years (2022-2025). By 31-March-2022 the loans-and-advances provision shortfall (Note 8.5, a broader all-facilities scope than the later Note 8.10/8.11's loans-only scope) stood at Tk.409.47m (required 2,882,093,468 vs maintained 2,472,624,029). Classified loans (Note 8.6, Main Operation + OBU) were Tk.3,883,231,597 (NPL 5.57%). No capital-adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosure found anywhere in this 50-page filing.
